# Locked EE baseline — the frozen benchmark

**Generated by** `scripts/step4_baseline.py`. **Do not edit.** This file is the fixed yardstick for gate G3 (PLAN §5). Regenerate only if the acceptance set itself changes.

- Rows scored: **9** (sealed batch withheld: 3 rows)
- Target: `T_exhaust_meas_C` — the only thermodynamic ground truth in the dataset (PLAN §0.2)


## The benchmark — two of them, and the difference matters

**Headline (as EE is normally quoted):** RMSE 0.5958 °C, max 1.0306 °C. This uses the per-batch `Alpha Avg`, which is **leaky** — see below.


**Gate G3 benchmark (matched protocol, out-of-sample):**

> **RMSE ≤ 0.6396 °C** and **max |err| ≤ 1.2336 °C**


This is EE's legacy equation with **one** alpha fitted on batch 1 only, scored on batches 2–3 which it never saw. Any candidate module is measured the same way, on the same rows, with the same number of parameters fitted on the same batch. Beating the headline number instead would be beating a benchmark that has already seen the answer.


### Leakage hierarchy — why there are two numbers


| Policy | Params | Fitted on | Leaky? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Per-row fitted alpha | 9 (one per row) | the row it predicts | **totally** — 0.000 is arithmetic, not skill |
| Per-batch `Alpha Avg` | 1 per batch | rows of the *same* batch | **yes** — each batch's parameter saw that batch's measurements |
| Single global alpha | 1 | the mean of all batches' fitted alphas | **mildly** — derived from every batch, including those scored |
| **Locked alpha / locked UA** | **1** | **batch 1 only** | **no — genuinely out-of-sample on batches 2–3** |
| Adiabatic | 0 | nothing | no |

The practical consequence: EE's apparent 0.43 °C on batches 2–3 under the leaky policy becomes **0.6396 °C** once it is held to the same standard we hold ourselves to.

### Why the first row reads ~0.000

Each row was given its own free parameter chosen to reproduce that row's own measurement. Zero degrees of freedom remain, so a near-zero error is arithmetically guaranteed and says nothing about predictive skill.


Fitted alpha per row: 0.1493, 0.0944, 0.0463, 0.1392, 0.0959, 0.1138, 0.1597, 0.1005, 0.1143 — a 3.5× spread across rows at essentially constant airflow. A physical equipment property does not vary like that; the parameter is absorbing model error (PLAN §2.5).

## Notes

- The **adiabatic** row is a genuine zero-parameter, zero-fitting prediction: pure thermodynamics with published constants. It is +2.326 °C biased, which is exactly the gap the single heat-loss parameter exists to close (PLAN §0.5).

- **Locked UA** was fitted on batch 1 only and then frozen; the other batches are genuine out-of-sample predictions.

- The sealed batch is withheld from every policy above. It is run exactly once, at the end (PLAN §0.4).
